title: Ultrafast microwave synthesis of Ti-based MXenes with high yields
content:

Jovana Paskaš, Miloš Dujović, Milica Govedarica, Vasa Radonić, Vladimir V. Srdić, Nikola Kanas
We report a microwave-assisted method for synthesizing MXenes that accelerates hydrofluoric acid etching of MAX phases by ∼500-fold compared to conventional approaches.
